page.layout: One column of running text, with the heading "REFVTATIO ALIORVM" set above the passage in spaced capitals and a smaller italic title beneath it. No notes stand in the margins of this printed page. The narrow strip at the left edge is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. The page number is centred at the head.

main_text.p: sanctificaverimus, haud terrebimur. exstant deinde tot confessiones & apologiæ, ex quibus vel imperitissi-mi percipiunt, si velint, qualis sit doctrina nostra, quales sint nostri cœtus in quos tantâ rabie furiosi illi exardescunt.{s}[?] Eos, qui subsistunt in ejusmodi ecclesiis, sese exponere manifesto periculo. Resp. Equidem tempore parentum nostrorum multi viri boni, velut oves mactationi destinatæ, ad extrema quæq; sunt redacti; attamen fortis Dei manus, quâ patienter expectarunt, sese armata exseruit, quotiescunq; ita opus, & Domino ita visum fuit, tum ad pauperes ex affli-ctione eruendos, tum ad contemto-res vindicandos, qui nunc tanta se-curitate exsultant.
main_text.head: REFVTATIO ALIORVM ARgumentorum, quibus Pontificii promiscuè impetunt ecclesias protestantium,tùm publicas tùm privatas.
main_text.p: AJunt porrò : Grave crimen esse ab ecclesiâ discedere. Resp. Est crambe millies recocta: equidem grave crimen est ab ecclesiâ D ?[?] Chri-

page.notes: The initial "A" of "AJunt" is a large decorative letter. The superscript mark before "Eos" is unclear and is marked [?]. The "D ?" at the foot of the page is unclear, and the "?" may be a printed mark or a letter; it is left as read. The heading's "AR" is set larger than the rest of the word. The left strip with the fragments of the facing page is not transcribed.
